decisions.decision: Name is HaulOut / haul out / family sentence with Detangler. Domain haulout.dev.
decisions.rationale: Frozen in SPEC §1. Do not reopen.

decisions.decision: Primary vehicle is a Tampermonkey userscript. Bookmarklet/console are fallbacks. No HaulOut server.
decisions.rationale: Must run in the page origin with the user's cookies. Same-origin fetch only.

decisions.decision: Markdown + JSON only in v1. Filename haulout-YYYY-MM-DD-<platform>-<slug>.
decisions.rationale: Readable, diffable, Obsidian/Detangler-friendly. YAML front matter on Markdown.

decisions.decision: Scope is the open conversation, not a bulk archive. No telemetry.
decisions.rationale: Official takeouts already exist. Local-only is the product promise.

decisions.decision: Site is FilePress static on haulout.dev. LocalSlip lease haulout-site:5198. LocalHelm enroll haulout. pnpm.
decisions.rationale: House standard stack. One page is enough for v1. No PocketBase — nothing to persist in a backend.

decisions.decision: Repo layout: haulout.user.js at root; fallback/; docs/; examples/; site/; scripts/.
decisions.rationale: GitHub raw and Greasy Fork need a stable root userscript path. Root was a flat dump.

decisions.decision: Detangler is the next tool, not a HaulOut mode.
Prune Phase 2 CRUD/PocketBase and Phase 7 auth/payment exit criteria.
decisions.rationale: Local-only userscript + static site. Archetype is product but persistence is A-local.

sessions.summary: Kickoff: ingested SPEC.md, moved root files into docs/fallback/examples/site, renamed userscript to haulout.user.js, applied frozen strings, scaffolded FilePress + LocalSlip + LocalHelm.
